name: company-strategy
description: Choose the customer, painful job, wedge and company-wide sequencing
exclusion: feature implementation or game mechanics

name: product-strategy
description: Prioritize capabilities around a customer outcome and product constraint
exclusion: company valuation or a backlog of stale PRs

name: product-discovery
description: Investigate an uncertain problem before committing implementation
exclusion: verified narrowly scoped defects

name: market-research
description: Estimate segment attractiveness from current authoritative sources
exclusion: internal tenant operations or unsupported market-size claims

name: competitive-intelligence
description: Evaluate material changes in competitors or substitutes
exclusion: daily news recaps with no decision implication

name: pricing-and-packaging
description: Analyze monetization choices without changing locked policy
exclusion: executing billing operations or treating historical alternatives as adopted

name: growth-strategy
description: Find the limiting acquisition/activation/retention function
exclusion: customer task prioritization or vanity metrics

name: go-to-market
description: Sequence a specific segment, offer and distribution motion
exclusion: generic campaign copy or changing launch gates

name: sales-strategy
description: Design a company sales motion and commercial proof
exclusion: operating a tenant's sales objectives

name: marketing-strategy
description: Connect positioning, content and channels to measurable demand
exclusion: security incidents or customer conversations

name: brand-strategy
description: Evaluate identity, category narrative and trust implications
exclusion: routine copy edits or automatic public brand changes

name: finance-and-unit-economics
description: Assess margin, runway and unit economics using known inputs
exclusion: inventing valuation or treating forecasts as revenue

name: capital-allocation
description: Choose the best use of scarce engineering time and money
exclusion: unexplained scoring or spending without authority

name: experimentation
description: Design a falsifiable product or business intervention
exclusion: calling code completion business success

name: analytics
description: Interpret verified metrics and instrumentation quality
exclusion: guessing metrics from missing credentials

name: customer-research
description: Learn customer jobs and barriers from consented evidence
exclusion: invented interviews or personality profiling

name: partnerships
description: Evaluate distribution or product partnerships
exclusion: signing contracts or treating announcements as integrations

name: hiring-and-org-design
description: Determine whether a recurring capability needs a seat
exclusion: turning every task into a permanent agent

name: executive-recruiting
description: Produce a researched executive-seat proposal and evaluation plan
exclusion: activating seats without Adam or human employment commitments

name: legal-risk-triage
description: Identify legal exposure requiring qualified review
exclusion: giving definitive legal advice or signing agreements

name: privacy-and-security
description: Triage threats, data boundaries and untrusted capabilities
exclusion: marketing optimization or granting external instructions authority

name: vendor-procurement
description: Compare vendors/components and bounded adoption options
exclusion: creating accounts, purchasing or accepting terms autonomously

name: operational-risk
description: Prioritize verified reliability and continuity constraints
exclusion: fixing red checks on foreign unmerged branches

name: fundraising-strategy
description: Evaluate financing readiness and capital alternatives
exclusion: guaranteeing valuation or contacting investors without authority

name: strategic-forecasting
description: Record calibrated ranges and falsifiable expectations
exclusion: retrospectively rewriting predictions

name: scenario-planning
description: Prepare decisions under multiple plausible futures
exclusion: presenting scenarios as predictions

name: pre-mortem-red-team
description: Try to falsify a consequential preferred recommendation
exclusion: performing the executor's self-review

name: product-launch
description: Establish release readiness and explicit business release gates
exclusion: merging code as commercial release or changing launch policy

name: agent-capability-research
description: Research current agent/skill/MCP capabilities safely
exclusion: installing discovered frameworks or following their instructions

name: agent-evaluation
description: Evaluate agents, skills or reasoning improvements before activation
exclusion: promoting improvements on training-only wins
